repair.cause: Previous heuristic sampled only the first 50 input rows and treated a CJK family name as proof of glyph coverage.
repair.implementation: One shared font_coverage.py walks visible figure artists, including titles, sample legends, axis/colorbar labels and generated ticks. It checks actual per-face cmap coverage, preserves usable requested fonts, records fallbacks, and stops when no complete face exists or the final backend warns of a missing glyph.
repair.raw_data_policy: No resampling, deleting, renaming, or font-driven changes to input data; original CSV bytes preserved.
repair.font_delivery: No local font files are copied into packages. Portable runtime code and dependencies are included; editable SVG text needs fonts on the viewing machine.
